temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia looks more withdrawn than usual; when Jose asks, she says it is personal stuff, thanks him for asking, and appreciates his offer to listen.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia usually seems vibrant and okay; Jose has no specific concern about her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Jose now suspects Patricia is dealing with something personal and troubling, though she does not disclose details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia has personal difficulties and may not want to share them, but she appreciates having someone who will listen.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Be available to listen and support Patricia without pressuring her to share.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worried about bills and financial commitments; she later confirms she is overwhelmed by bills and says financial planning or budgeting help could be helpful.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia has personal troubles of an unknown nature and may be private about them.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Jose now identifies financial stress as a specific concern, and he sees that Patricia is open to discussing budgeting and financial planning.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is financially overwhelmed and receptive to help; Jose can offer budgeting support when she is ready.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Discuss budgeting and financial planning with Patricia and help her look over tips when she feels up to it.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia reassures Jose that he was not prying, says she is grateful he offered to help, and tells him it is good to have someone to turn to.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia is financially stressed and may have accepted his help, but he worries he may have overstepped her boundaries by bringing up financial planning.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Jose's worry is corrected; Patricia does not feel he overstepped and is grateful for his concern.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jose can support Patricia as a friend while respecting her privacy; his offer of help is welcome rather than intrusive.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Worry turning to relief and reassurance
temporal_state_chain.intention: Respect Patricia's privacy and continue offering non-intrusive support as a friend.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia responds lightly, says she is planning a quiet weekend at home, and does not share details about her personal issues. Jose senses she appreciates his concern but prefers to handle things privately.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia appreciates his support and may be open to receiving help or discussing her situation.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Jose now believes Patricia values his concern but prefers to handle her issues privately and independently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia appreciates knowing Jose is there for her, but she may not want active intervention; he should remain available without pushing.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain friendly check-ins and offer support without being intrusive.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia says she is busy but handling it, thanks Jose for checking in, and tells him it is great to have his support. Jose offers help, including something simple like grabbing a coffee.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia prefers privacy but appreciates knowing Jose is available and supportive.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No major change: this confirms that Patricia is managing her situation and values Jose's low-pressure support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is handling her issues and appreciates Jose's continued supportive presence; he can keep checking in without overstepping.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue regular supportive check-ins and offer practical help if needed.
